title: 🚩 How to Spot Red Flags in a Guy. Part 1
body: Look at his friends before you look at him. Count how many girls he calls "just a friend," then check who he follows on Instagram. Ask about his ex and listen for the word "crazy." If every ex is crazy, he is the common factor. Notice how he talks about his mother, because that is the preview of how he will talk to you. If he never says sorry, he is not strong, he is just unpracticed. And if he is "emotionally unavailable" and "mysterious," he is not deep. He is busy with someone else.
caption:
Send this to the friend who defends him.

title: 🚩 How to Spot Red Flags in a Girl. Part 1
body: She says "I'm not dramatic" while typing a paragraph. She says "it's fine" and it is not fine. Every guy she knows is "just a friend" and they all like her photos at 2am. She says "nothing" when you ask what's wrong, then gets upset you believed her. She has a Close Friends list you are not on, eight months in. Her last relationship was "toxic" but she still checks his story daily. And she says "I don't care what people think" while checking who viewed her story for the third time this hour.
caption:
Tag the friend who says it's fine.

#redflags #dating #rishta #relationships #pakistan #relatable

title: 🚩 Red Flags in a Rishta Meeting. Part 1
body: The mother answers every question and he nods like it is a school viva. Within ten minutes someone asks your salary, your height, and your cousin's salary. They say "we are very simple people" and then ask about your car. Then everyone leaves you two alone for twenty minutes to decide the rest of your life. You ask about his favourite movie. He says "Marvel or DC" like it is the final round. The aunty says "we will let you know" and the decision was made before you walked in. Drink the chai. That part is free.
caption:
Send this to someone with a rishta meeting this week.

#redflags #dating #rishta #relationships #pakistan #relatable

title: 🚩 You Are Not in the Friend Zone. You Are in the Maybe Zone.
body: She said "I'm not looking for a relationship right now." You heard "not yet." She meant "not with you." You still send her reels every day and she still replies with a laughing emoji, and you call that progress. You check her story before you check your own messages. The friend zone at least has a door. The maybe zone has had its lights off for months. Someone who likes you does not make you guess for six months.
caption:
Send this to the friend still waiting for a reply.

#redflags #dating #rishta #relationships #pakistan #relatable

title: 🚩 Red Flags on a First Date. Part 1
body: He orders for both of you without asking. He talks about his ex for forty minutes and calls it "being honest." He snaps his fingers at the waiter and says "bhai" like it is a full sentence. He "forgot" his wallet but mentioned his dad's business twice. He arrives with a friend "just to drop him off" and the friend stays. And he asks "so what are your plans after marriage" before the food arrives. Eat the dessert, then block him.
caption:
Which one happened to you? Be honest.

#redflags #dating #rishta #relationships #pakistan #relatable

title: 🚩 Red Flags When He Texts. Part 1
body: He replies "haha" to a paragraph. He says "can't talk, family is around" every night at 11, and every night at 11 he is online. Three weeks of daily texts and zero plans to meet. A talking stage that long is not a talking stage, it is a pen pal. He sends "good morning" to you and the same one to eleven other people. He leaves you on seen for three hours, then sends a meme like it is an apology. And when you get upset he says "you're overthinking," which means you were right.
caption:
Screenshot the "hey stranger" and send it to your group chat.

#redflags #dating #rishta #relationships #pakistan #relatable

title: 🚩 How to Know You Are Her Emotional Support Contact
body: She told you about her family drama before she told you her favourite food. Every chat starts at 11pm with "can I tell you something." You know her whole childhood and she has never asked what you do. She replies fast when she is sad and slowly when she is happy. When she feels better, she disappears for a week. You are not her boyfriend. You are a free therapist with a good profile photo.
caption:
Tag the friend who is everyone's free therapist.

#redflags #dating #rishta #relationships #pakistan #relatable

title: 🚩 How to Never Date a Playboy. Part 1
body: Check who he calls first when something happens. If he calls everyone "bro" so nothing needs a label, that is on purpose. If his Close Friends list has forty girls he "doesn't really talk to anymore," that is the roster. Ask about his last situationship and count how fast it becomes "it wasn't that deep." If every date is the same cafe and the same table, you are one of several. And if his friends are extra nice to you, in a slightly sorry way, they know something.
caption:
Tag the friend who needs this before the weekend.

#redflags #dating #rishta #relationships #pakistan #relatable

title: 🚩 Red Flags in His Instagram. Part 1
body: His Close Friends list is bigger than his follower count, and you are not on it. He follows nine hundred girls and has never posted one. His bio says entrepreneur and his only post is a gym mirror selfie from 2022. His highlights are called "memories" and none of them are you. He likes your photo from 2019 at 3am, then asks "why are you so dry." And he says "I don't really use Instagram" while watching your story within a minute of every post.
caption:
Check his Close Friends list before you reply.

#redflags #dating #rishta #relationships #pakistan #relatable

title: 🚩 The Taxi Light Theory. Part 1
body: Some men are not ready until suddenly they are. For three years he was "focusing on his career." He told four different girls he does not believe in labels. Then he met someone in March and his mother knew by April. It was not because she was better. His taxi light came on, and you were not the one in the car. Do not ask what she has that you do not. Timing is not a compliment.
caption:
Tag the friend whose ex got engaged in two months.

#redflags #dating #rishta #relationships #pakistan #relatable

title: 🚩 Who Has to Approve Your Marriage. Part 1
body: Approval needed: his mother, his father, his uncle in Dubai, his khala who has opinions, his cousin who has never met you, and the aunty next door. Not needed: his opinion. He says "I'm trying to convince them" for three years and calls it a fight. You are not in a relationship. You are in a long approval process, and the committee only meets on Eid.
caption:
Tag someone whose rishta is stuck in committee.

#redflags #dating #rishta #relationships #pakistan #relatable

title: 🚩 How to Find a Spiritual Partner. Part 1
body: He knows your sun, moon and rising sign but not your last name. He says "we have a soul connection" on day two. When you ask where he was, he says "your energy is so heavy." Every breakup is Mercury retrograde. He checks his Co-Star before replying. He has cut cords with five exes and returned none of their calls. He says "I'm on my healing journey" and cancels because "my energy is low." He is not spiritual. He is unavailable with a crystal.
caption:
Tag the friend who asked your moon sign on the first date.

title: 🚩 How to Read a Rishta Profile. Part 1
body: Fair, tall, slim, doctor, homely, not too religious, not too modern, and no opinions. Must have a high paying degree but will not be allowed to work. Must be independent and obedient. Must cook well, and also look like she has never been near a kitchen. That is the basic package. What he offers: a mother, and a flat his dad owns. Nobody asks what he is like. He is "very simple."
caption:
Send this to a girl who has read a rishta profile.
